headline: Jackson Financial Declares $0.90 Dividend and Adds $1 Billion Buyback
summary: Jackson Financial declared a $0.90 dividend and authorized an additional $1 billion share repurchase program.
why: Jackson Financial is a major US retirement services and annuity provider, and capital return announcements directly impact shareholder yields.

impacts.name: Jackson Financial
impacts.why: Dividend declarations and large share buybacks generally support stock prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Announcing a substantial share buyback authorization and dividend returns capital to shareholders, boosting equity demand.
